results.title: Silence
results.overview: While preparing for her first, big piano concert, Laura gets diagnosed with a serious inner ear disorder, that inhibits her ability to play properly. At home, things are falling apart, when Laura and her mom get into a big fight.

results.title: The Lost Princess
results.overview: After an Ayahuasca vision transports him to a haunted castle, Alec meets Hanna who tales him the story of her mother's forced marriage and how the forbidden passion with her father was in danger when the princess pregnancy became obvious

results.title: My Uncle Jens
results.overview: Akam, a young literature teacher, lives a comfortable life in Oslo until his estranged uncle from the Iranian part of Kurdistan comes for a surprise visit. Despite limited space in his shared flat with friends, Akam feels obligated to invite his uncle to stay for a few days. However, his uncle quickly makes himself at home and shows no sign of leaving anytime soon. Torn between his sense of familial duty and growing tension in the flat, Akam begins to suspect there's more to his uncle's visit than just a casual trip. What follows is a series of revelations and unexpected events that could have life changing consequences for them both.

results.title: Fanny och Alexander på Galeasen
results.overview: Ingmar Bergman's classic film adapted for the stage.

results.title: Red Circle
results.overview: Fikayo Holloway, a journalist from a wealthy socialite family, is on the verge of uncovering a powerful crime ring in Lagos, whose atrocities have hit close to home.

results.title: In the Shadow of The Glen
results.original_title: In the Shadow of The Glen
results.overview: Ardclough Dramatic Society present a complete performance of J.M Synge's In the Shadow of The Glen

results.title: Her Dance
results.overview: A day in the life of a trans dancer excluded from her prestigious company in Buenos Aires. As her world and landmarks crumble, she feels herself gradually disappearing.

results.title: Uñitas Estrelladas
results.overview: Julia wants to make a call on the old public phone on her street, but the people waiting beside her seem to prevent her from doing so, making her increasingly nervous…

results.title: Sole Survivor
results.overview: A self-absorbed, 21-year-old influencer visits a mysterious shoe store, only to be trapped by an obsessed admirer. He must choose between saving his career or surrendering to a fan willing to kill for his love.

results.title: Kleks Academy 2
results.overview: Ada returns to the magical Kleks Academy to solve the mystery of her robot friend's origins, while Professor Kleks seeks answers in the real world.

results.title: Castling
results.overview: A detective alienated from his own life doesn’t know whether it was him… or his shadow.

results.title: TNA Final Resolution 2025
results.overview: TNA Final Resolution 2025 was held on December 5 at the El Paso County Coliseum in El Paso, Texas, and featured multiple championship matches, including a TNA World Title bout between Frankie Kazarian and JDC, plus Mike Santana vs. Charlie Dempsey, The Hardys vs. Tyson Dupont & Tyriek Igwe for the Tag Team Championship, and a Street Fight between Matt Cardona and Mance Warner.

results.title: My Husband's Mistress
results.overview: Anna Kent, a CEO at the top of her game has reached a business impasse with her husband and company COO, Brill Cooper. However, it's his stealth betrayal of her -- both sexually and professionally that has her unleashing a fury that will not be quashed. Because Anna believes, "the only unfair fight is the fight you lose."

results.title: 33 Photos from the Ghetto
results.overview: The film traces two families, one of which is Jewish, who preserved the images for decades but hadn’t brought them to light. 80 years after their creation, the son of the photographer finds the forgotten negatives and launches an investigation. With a team of researchers, archivists, and animators who use near-forensic precision to reconstruct locations and contexts, they trace the circumstances of those tragic days and the lives captured in each frame.

results.title: Bhoothayanam
results.overview: Lonely and desperate, an elderly matriarch will go to any length to be reunited with her beloved granddaughter.

results.title: The Harpies
results.overview: In a world where Greek mythological creatures are commonplace, two young people find themselves on the run. A woman, fleeing her ex boyfriend, accompanied by her friend/annoying admirer; find themselves seeking refuge in an abandoned lumber mill. Little do they know, a dangerous harpy calls it home.

results.title: Tomb Watcher
results.original_title: สุสานคนเป็น
results.overview: When Lunthom passed away, her husband and his mistress seized the opportunity to live openly as a couple. However, when moved into their villa, they discovering a glass coffin containing Lunthom's body in the house. Leading to a terrifying path of revenge.

results.title: Long Pork
results.overview: In a Post-Roe America where theocracy reigns, a renowned butcher meets the political predator responsible for the killing of her daughter and exacts bloody revenge, setting the stage for a revolution…

results.title: Behind the Shadows
results.overview: Au Yeung Wai Yip is a private detective who has been focusing on missing persons and adultery investigations for many years. One day, he received a "special" commission: the owner of the travel agency had asked him to investigate his girlfriend, who happened to be Au Yeung Wai Yip’s wife.Being a private detective, he is used to looking for the truth with cold eyes for his clients, but he finds it difficult to face the truth about their own marriage. Unable to withstand his inner torment, Au Yeung Wai Yip gave up on another ongoing case - a client's search for his missing fiancée - and went to the hotel to catch the adulterer. Unfortunately, the marriage could not be saved in the end, and the client's fiancée was killed after he left. A seemingly ordinary affair turned into a murderous incident!
